tools.purpose: Local DICOM inventory, JPEG Lossless media decoding, ultrasound-region modality classification, and calibrated CWD/PWD spectral trace extraction for view-classifier validation.
tools.input_contract: A de-identified echo case folder containing DICOM US/SR/PR objects and sidecar files.
tools.output_contract: runs/view_classifier_validation/<case_id> JSON artifacts plus derived local media and spectral trace artifacts.
tools.validation_scope: Focused unit tests and A1-A5 local validation workflow; no clinical validation claimed.
limitations: View labels use ranked metadata, DICOM region, visual-feature, and acquisition-order evidence and require independent review.
PWD sample-site interpretation is not converted to severity without explicit site evidence.
PHI-risk DICOM tag values and private values are redacted from JSON outputs.
